title: A Poor Grandma Teaches a Rich Man a Lesson #kindness
description:
An impatient man pushed an elderly woman aside and took her place at an ATM. When the machine refused to give him any cash, he lost his temper and walked away.

Moments later, the ATM unexpectedly dispensed a stack of money. The elderly woman picked it up and hurried down the street, making it seem like she planned to keep it.

But instead, she found the man sitting inside his luxury car and returned every dollar he had left behind.

Ashamed of how he treated her, the man offered her part of the money as a reward. She simply smiled, refused, and walked away.

A powerful reminder that true honesty and kindness are worth more than money.
